note: checks go red with no review change. A reviews-only watcher emits nothing, so 'no review yet' and 'unreviewable, CI is red' are the same silence. updatedAt is deliberately IDENTICAL across the pair: whether a check-run completion moves a PR's updatedAt is not something this fixture was recorded to answer, so it asserts the narrow thing instead — a red check is seen on its own merit, with no help from the backstop.
